items.exampleEn: I attended a writing workshop last weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我上週末參加了一個寫作工作坊。

items.exampleEn: Smoking is not allowed in the workplace.
Let's stop here and rest for ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 我們在這裡停下來休息十分鐘吧。

items.exampleEn: The school hired a famous writer to give a talk.
items.exampleZh: 學校請了一位知名作家來演講。

items.exampleEn: Nobody volunteered to clean the meeting room.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人自願打掃會議室。

items.exampleEn: He missed a week of work because of illness.
items.exampleZh: 他因為生病，一個星期沒去上班。

items.exampleEn: The new factory will bring employment to the town.
items.exampleZh: 新工廠會為小鎮帶來就業機會。

items.exampleEn: Babies feel safe when they have a regular routine.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶有規律的作息時會覺得安心。

items.sentenceEn: Our workplace has a small kitchen for the staff.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的工作場所有一間給員工用的小廚房。

items.audioEn: The library needs people to volunteer on weekends. You can sign up at the front desk.
items.audioZh: 圖書館週末需要志工，可以在櫃台報名。

items.sentenceEn: We hired a car for our trip to the south.
items.sentenceZh: 我們租了一輛車去南部旅行。

items.sentenceEn: Exercise is part of my daily routine.
items.sentenceZh: 運動是我每天作息的一部分。

items.stemEn: The company will ____ ten new workers next month.
items.stemZh: 公司下個月會雇用十名新員工。

items.stemEn: The ____ taught me how to make pottery.
items.stemZh: 這個工作坊教我怎麼做陶藝。

items.passageEn: Sara's daily routine changed a lot last year. After a long illness, she decided to find a job closer to home. A small bakery hired her, and her new workplace is only five minutes from her apartment. She starts at seven and takes a short rest at ten. On weekends, she volunteers at a cooking workshop for children. She says that finding employment near home has given her more time for her family. Her life is incredibly busy, but she is happy.
items.passageZh: 去年 Sara 的日常作息改變了很多。病了很長一段時間之後，她決定找一份離家近一點的工作。一家小麵包店雇用了她，新的工作地點離她的公寓只有五分鐘。她七點開始工作，十點休息一下。週末時，她在兒童烹飪工作坊當志工。她說，在家附近找到工作讓她有更多時間陪家人。她的生活忙得不得了，但她很快樂。

items.promptZh: 他每天下午會休息半小時。
referenceEn: He rests for half an hour every afternoon.
Every afternoon, he takes a thirty-minute rest.
rubricZh: rest 可當動詞（例如 rest for…）、名詞（例如 take a rest）等
說習慣多用現在簡單式，動詞配合第三人稱單數（例如 rests、takes a rest）
「半小時」可寫 half an hour、thirty minutes 等

items.instructionZh: 用 routine 造一個句子，說說你的日常作息。
referenceEn: My routine on weekdays is quite boring.
I go for a run every morning as part of my routine.
rubricZh: routine 表示「例行公事、日常作息」
可用 my routine、part of my routine 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
